newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes down on weak overnight in London.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes down on weak overnight in London.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell six cents to 14.39 ringgit ($5.72) a kg on Monday after tracking a fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"I think the local market tried to correct the high premium against the LME, but instead saw it rise as the price fall was not enough," said a trader. The LME fell $65 on Friday.
Traders said offers to sell overwhelmed bids to buy by 105 tonnes to 40. Turnover was 46 tonnes against 63 on Friday. The premium against London widened to $105 against $55.
